text: Attention, Fresh Harvest shoppers. Thank you for shopping with us this evening. We'd like to remind you that our store will be closing in thirty minutes, at nine o'clock. Please bring your final selections to the checkout area at the front of the store. Tonight, only registers one through four are open, so the self-checkout machines near the exit are a faster option if you have fewer than ten items. Also, starting tomorrow, our bakery department will open an hour earlier, at six a.m., so you can pick up fresh bread and pastries on your way to work. Finally, if you haven't joined our rewards program yet, ask any cashier for an application form tonight and receive a coupon for five dollars off your next purchase.

text: Hi, this is Marcus Bell from Lakeview Property Management, calling for Ms. Andrea Silva. I'm returning your message about the leaking pipe under your kitchen sink. I'm sorry to hear about the trouble. I've arranged for one of our plumbers to come by your apartment tomorrow between ten a.m. and noon. He'll need to turn off the water to the whole unit for about an hour while he replaces the pipe, so you may want to fill a few containers beforehand. If that time doesn't work for you, please call me back at 555-0182 before five o'clock today so I can reschedule. Otherwise, the plumber will use the spare key we keep in the office if you're not home. Thanks for your patience.

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
options: To respond to a maintenance problem
questions.explain: "I'm returning your message about the leaking pipe" → gọi lại về sự cố cần sửa chữa.

A new sink will be installed.

Send an e-mail to the office
Call the speaker by the end of the day

text: Are you ready to get in shape for summer? Brightline Fitness has just opened its newest location on Carver Avenue, right across from City Park. Our spacious facility features modern weight machines, an indoor pool, and more than forty group classes every week. To celebrate our opening, we're offering a special deal this month only: sign up for any plan that includes access to the pool, which means our Plus plan and above, and we'll take ten dollars off your monthly fee for the entire first year. All new members also receive a free session with a personal trainer, who'll design a workout program just for you. Stop by our front desk any day between six a.m. and ten p.m., or visit our website to take a virtual tour.

questions.explain: "All new members also receive a free session with a personal trainer" → buổi tập miễn phí với huấn luyện viên.

text: In local business news, Harbor Electronics announced this morning that it will build a new manufacturing plant on the east side of Port Wells. The company, which makes components for solar panels, says the plant will create about three hundred jobs when it opens late next year. Mayor Linda Choi welcomed the decision, saying it will bring much-needed investment to the area. However, some residents have raised concerns about increased truck traffic on Elm Road, which is the main route to the site. In response, the company says it is working with city planners to build a separate access road. A public meeting to discuss the project will be held next Tuesday evening at the community center, and all residents are invited to attend.

questions.q: What is the news report mainly about?
questions.explain: "it will build a new manufacturing plant" → tin chính là dự án xây nhà máy.

questions.q: What concern have some residents expressed?
questions.explain: "concerns about increased truck traffic on Elm Road" → lo ngại giao thông tăng.

questions.q: What will happen next Tuesday?
options: A new road will be completed.
A meeting will be held for residents.
The mayor will visit the site.
questions.explain: "A public meeting ... will be held next Tuesday evening" → họp với cư dân.

text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Ashford Chocolate Factory. My name is Grace, and I'll be your guide for the next ninety minutes. We'll begin in the history room, where you'll see the original copper kettles our founder used back in 1922. Then we'll walk through the production floor, where our chocolate bars are made. For safety and hygiene reasons, everyone must wear the hairnet and shoe covers you received at the entrance before we go inside. Also, please note that photography isn't permitted on the production floor, as some of our recipes and machinery are confidential. Don't worry, though. There'll be plenty of chances to take pictures in the tasting room at the end of the tour, where you'll sample five of our most popular flavors.

questions.q: Where most likely are the listeners?
questions.explain: "welcome to the Ashford Chocolate Factory" và "production floor" → cơ sở sản xuất thực phẩm.

questions.q: Why are listeners not allowed to take photos on the production floor?
options: The machines are sensitive to flashes.
questions.explain: "some of our recipes and machinery are confidential" → một số quy trình được giữ bí mật.

questions.q: What will listeners do at the end of the tour?
questions.explain: "in the tasting room ... you'll sample five of our most popular flavors" → nếm thử sản phẩm.

text: Before we wrap up, I want to talk about the customer survey results that came in on Friday. Overall, people are happy with our delivery speed, which is great news. But a large number of customers said our mobile app is difficult to use, especially when they try to track their orders. We've had this complaint before. Last year, we promised to redesign the app, and frankly, that project kept getting pushed back. Well, I've talked with the board, and this time it's a top priority. We've hired an outside design firm, and they'll start next month. In the meantime, I'd like each of you to collect specific examples from the customers you speak with. Please send them to Lena on the product team by the end of the week.

questions.q: What is the speaker mainly discussing?
questions.explain: "the customer survey results" → chủ đề là phản hồi của khách hàng.

questions.q: What does the speaker imply when he says, "We've had this complaint before"?
options: A problem has not been fixed for some time.
He disagrees with the survey results.
questions.explain: Ngay sau đó ông nói dự án sửa app "kept getting pushed back" → vấn đề tồn tại lâu mà chưa được khắc phục.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do?
options: Test a new version of the app
questions.explain: "I'd like each of you to collect specific examples from the customers" → thu thập ví dụ từ khách hàng.

text: You're listening to WKRT Radio, and it's time for your weekend traffic update. This Saturday, the annual City Marathon will take place downtown, and several streets will be closed from six a.m. until two p.m. The biggest impact will be on Grand Boulevard, which will be completely closed to vehicles. Because of this, the bus line that serves the State University campus will be suspended until the race is over. Other bus routes will run as normal, though you should expect some delays near the city center. If you're planning to drive downtown, officials recommend parking at the Westside Garage and taking the free shuttle that will run every fifteen minutes. Coming up after the break, we'll have the weekend weather forecast.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the broadcast?
options: To report on a traffic accident
To inform listeners about closures for a race
questions.explain: "the annual City Marathon ... several streets will be closed" → thông báo đóng đường vì cuộc đua.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which bus route will be suspended on Saturday morning?

questions.q: What will listeners hear next?
questions.explain: "Coming up after the break, we'll have the weekend weather forecast" → bản tin thời tiết.

text: Good evening, and thank you all for coming to the Northfield Chamber of Commerce annual awards dinner. It's now my great pleasure to introduce this year's winner of the Business Leader of the Year award, Ms. Hannah Osei. Ten years ago, Hannah opened a small coffee shop with just two employees. Today, Osei Roasters operates twelve cafés across the region and employs more than two hundred people. But what impressed our committee most was not her company's growth. It was her commitment to the community. Through her training program, Hannah has helped over a hundred young people gain their first job experience. After she accepts the award, Hannah will say a few words, and then we'll move on to dessert, served, appropriately, with coffee from Osei Roasters.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the speech?
questions.explain: "introduce this year's winner of the Business Leader of the Year award" → giới thiệu người nhận giải.

questions.q: According to the speaker, what impressed the committee most?

The recipient's support for young people
questions.explain: "not her company's growth... her commitment to the community" qua chương trình giúp "young people gain their first job experience".

questions.q: What will happen after the award is presented?
questions.explain: "After she accepts the award, Hannah will say a few words" → người nhận giải sẽ phát biểu.

text: Okay, everyone, welcome to your first day on the warehouse team. Before you start, I'm going to show you how to use these handheld scanners. Every package that comes in must be scanned at the receiving dock, and again when it's placed on a shelf. If you skip the second scan, the system won't know where the item is, and someone will have to search the entire building for it. Believe me, that's not how you want to spend your afternoon. To scan, just point the device at the barcode and press the yellow button on the side. You'll hear a beep when it works. Now, I'll hand out a scanner to each of you, and we'll practice with the boxes on that table over there.

questions.q: Who most likely are the listeners?
questions.explain: "welcome to your first day on the warehouse team" → nhân viên kho mới.

questions.q: What does the speaker imply when she says, "Believe me, that's not how you want to spend your afternoon"?

She worked late the previous day.
Listeners should take a break later.
The afternoon shift is very busy.
questions.explain: Câu này nói ngay sau "someone will have to search the entire building" → tìm hàng thất lạc rất mất thời gian.

questions.q: What will listeners do next?
questions.explain: "I'll hand out a scanner ... and we'll practice" → thực hành dùng máy quét.

text: Hello, Ms. Fischer, this is Kevin Ortiz from Summit Office Furniture. I'm calling about your order of twenty ergonomic desk chairs for your new office. I know you're moving into the new space at the end of this month. We do have the same chair in dark gray, and we could deliver those next Monday. Honestly, most people can't tell the difference. If you'd like to switch to the gray chairs, or if you'd prefer to wait, just let me know by replying to the e-mail I sent you this morning. Either way, delivery will be free.

text: Good afternoon, passengers. This is an announcement for those traveling on the 3:15 express train to Brighton. text: Tired of spending your weekends cleaning? Let SparkleHome do it for you! For over fifteen years, SparkleHome has provided reliable, professional house cleaning to families throughout the Greenfield area. Our trained staff use only eco-friendly products that are safe for children and pets. You can book a one-time deep clean or schedule regular weekly or monthly visits, whatever fits your lifestyle. And unlike many other services, we never ask you to sign a long-term contract. Simply cancel whenever you like. This month, new customers who book online will receive twenty percent off their first visit. Just enter the code FRESH20 at checkout. Visit sparklehome.com today, and spend your next weekend doing something you actually enjoy.

text: Welcome to Stonebridge Castle. I'm Oliver, and I'll be taking you through the castle's main halls this morning. This building was completed in 1486, and remarkably, the same family lived here for nearly four hundred years. In a moment, we'll climb the north tower, which offers the best views of the river valley. I should mention, though: there are one hundred and twelve steps, and there's no elevator. If you'd prefer not to climb, you're welcome to wait in the garden courtyard, and I'll meet you there afterward. After the tower, we'll visit the great hall, where many of the family's original paintings are still on display. Please remember that touching the artwork isn't allowed. Okay, let's head toward the tower entrance now.

questions.q: Where is the tour taking place?
questions.explain: "Welcome to Stonebridge Castle", "completed in 1486" → lâu đài cổ.

questions.explain: "let's head toward the tower entrance now" → đi đến tháp.

text: Good evening. Here's a look at today's top business story. Shares of Meridian Airlines rose sharply this afternoon after the company announced a partnership with Pacific Sky, one of Asia's largest carriers. Under the agreement, passengers will be able to book connecting flights between the two airlines on a single ticket, and members of either airline's frequent flyer program will earn points on both. Meridian's CEO, Tomás Herrera, said the partnership will give customers access to more than ninety new destinations. Industry analysts say the deal could help Meridian compete with larger international rivals. The changes are expected to take effect in early spring. Stay with us. After a short break, we'll speak with a travel expert about what this means for holiday travelers.

questions.explain: "we'll speak with a travel expert" → phỏng vấn chuyên gia.

text: You're tuned to Morning Mix on 98.4 FM. I'm Rachel Dawson. Now, if you've been following our Community Garden Challenge, you'll know that we asked listeners to send in photos of their vegetable gardens. Well, we expected maybe fifty entries. We got over six hundred! Our judges have been working all week, and they've finally chosen the winner: Paul Mendez from Riverside, whose rooftop garden grows more than thirty kinds of vegetables. Paul wins a two-hundred-dollar gift card to Green Thumb Garden Center. Congratulations, Paul! You can see photos of his garden and the other finalists on our website. Paul will be joining us live in the studio right after this song, so stay tuned to hear his tips for growing vegetables in small spaces.

text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining today's webinar on international marketing. I'm Daniel Ward, and I'll be your host.
